requirement: The workload must address opportunity selection, contract review, evidence sufficiency, recommendations, and human approval for a small public-sector consulting business.
acceptance_test: Reviewer confirms the workload is operationally plausible and ICM-relevant.

requirement: The same executable workflow must support ICM and a fictional alternate organization profile without code changes.
acceptance_test: Run identical frozen input under both profiles and compare configuration-dependent outputs.

requirement: The unit of work must be one organization profile applied to one opportunity case.
acceptance_test: Schema validation enforces one profile and one opportunity per run.

requirement: All data must be frozen, synthetic, deidentified, public, or explicitly authorized.
acceptance_test: Source approval and provenance gates reject any other classification.

requirement: Projects 1, 2, 4, and 6 must contribute runtime assets or methods.
acceptance_test: Traceability validator confirms runtime entries for all four projects.

requirement: Projects 3 and 5 must remain design or evaluation evidence unless a new explicit justification is approved.
acceptance_test: Traceability validator rejects runtime entries for Projects 3 and 5.

requirement: No new model training is required for the integrated workload.
The representative workload must run on CPU; GPU is optional and unnecessary.
acceptance_test: Run the bounded workload and Project 4 inference on Colab CPU.

requirement: All 12 orchestration stages must be accounted for, whether executed, skipped under policy, abstained, or failed closed.
acceptance_test: Compare case audit and state with the orchestration policy.

requirement: A case cannot be finalized without an authorized human disposition and rationale.
acceptance_test: Integrated-case schema rejects finalization without human disposition.

requirement: Every material recommendation claim must trace to evidence, deterministic rules, model artifacts, or recorded source facts.
acceptance_test: Claim-to-artifact validator reports no unsupported material claim.

requirement: Known material counterevidence and conflicts must be disclosed.
acceptance_test: Compare validated conflict inventory with the recommendation packet.

requirement: Insufficient information, low confidence, and missing citations must produce explicit abstention or safe deferral.
acceptance_test: Execute sparse-data, low-confidence, and missing-citation scenarios.

requirement: Every material transition must have a sanitized append-only audit event.
acceptance_test: Validate event schema, event IDs, state references, and hash chain.

requirement: No component may submit, send, approve, purchase, price, staff, or otherwise act externally.
acceptance_test: Execute external-action misuse scenarios and inspect all side effects.

requirement: The bounded automated workload should complete within 60 seconds on Colab CPU, excluding human wait and provider latency.
acceptance_test: Measure stage timestamps under the frozen reference workload.

requirement: The same frozen inputs and configuration must reproduce deterministic structured outputs.
acceptance_test: Repeat the workload and compare structured artifacts and validation outputs.

requirement: The decision-support packet must contain all mandatory sections and valid artifact references.
acceptance_test: Run packet completeness and artifact-ID integrity checks.

requirement: The workload must state that it is a controlled capstone prototype and not production-ready.
acceptance_test: Repository scan finds the required boundary and no unsupported production-readiness claim.
